page_title: RBL 2-3 STU | RB Leipzig v Stuttgart 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jacob Bruun Larsen (VfB Stuttgart) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+3' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. RB Leipzig force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+1' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
87' Zsolt Low is forced to make a change. Yussuf Poulsen is unable to continue due to injury, Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) comes on.
86' Jacob Bruun Larsen (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner but it's cleared.
84' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Luca Jaquez is replaced by Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart).
84' Here comes a substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen (VfB Stuttgart) is brought on as a substitute for Nick Woltemade.
84' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The RB Leipzig players look gutted.
84' The RB Leipzig players halt their celebrations as referee Daniel Siebert makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
83' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is the lucky recipient of a rebound. He takes advantage of it and slots the ball low into the middle of the target, leaving the goalkeeper completely helpless.
83' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
80' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

78' 2 - 3 Deniz Undav passes to Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 2:3.
77' Here is a change. Arthur Vermeeren is going off and Zsolt Low gives the last tactical orders to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
77' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) will be replaced by Lois Openda.
74' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

74' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart). Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
73' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
72' The attendance is 47800.
71' David Raum (RB Leipzig) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
71' Daniel Siebert blows for a foul after Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. RB Leipzig have a free kick.
70' The corner from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is cleared away by the defence.
69' Substitution. Nikolas Nartey on for Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart).
69' Substitution. Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) in, Maximilian Mittelstadt out.
67' Zsolt Low has decided to substitute Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) and he is replaced by Yussuf Poulsen.
62' The foul by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) was seen by Daniel Siebert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
58' Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
58' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Jamie Leweling.

57' 2 - 2 The score has changed – 2:2. Maximilian Mittelstadt sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) jumps highest and plants a header inside the right post.
56' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) will take the corner.
54' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
52' An accurate cross picks out Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Daniel Siebert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Flag up against Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 1 Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) is the lucky recipient of a rebound. He takes advantage of it and powers the ball into the roof of the net, leaving the goalkeeper completely helpless.

44' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top right corner is blocked by Alexander Nubel, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
43' A long-range effort by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post.
42' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Alexander Nubel.
41' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
41' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniel Siebert signals. RB Leipzig will take a free kick.
33' What was Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
32' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and Daniel Siebert immediately signals a free kick.
28' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
27' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
23' 1 - 1 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) finds some space in the penalty area after latching onto a cross and finds the back of the net with a sweet header!
23' A cross from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
18' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Stuttgart will take a corner kick.
17' The ball goes out of play. Stuttgart are awarded a corner kick.

16' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away. Stuttgart earn a corner.
16' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
14' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
13' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

13' Good clearance! Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Stuttgart.
8' 1 - 0 GOAL! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Ridle Baku provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 1:0.
7' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
6' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
3' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! RB Leipzig will take the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
